say:1:1011716001:1.text: Eironn and Lyca have joined forces with the outsiders to disrupt the sacred ceremony under the Lucent Tree.
say:1:1011716001:1.source_cn: 埃隆、莱卡等人联合外族，公然在流荧树下破坏神圣的祝祈仪式。

say:2:1011716002:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫士，还不拦下他们？！

say:5:1011716004:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I'm the captain of the Dusk Patrollers. This is a diary we found from a northern village. It was left behind by a Wilder.
say:5:1011716004:1.source_cn: 各位，我是薄暮巡游队的队长。这是我们从北方村子里取回的...

say:6:1011716005:1.text: His village has been corrupted and is devoid of life! Please take a look at this diary, it is written in blood and tears!
say:6:1011716005:1.source_cn: 他所在的村子已经被腐化吞没，毫无生机！请看看这篇日记，...

say:7:1011716006:0.text: Why doesn't Master Eomir come here anymore? Where are the Thorned Guards? Alas, I must leave... Farewell, my village!
say:7:1011716006:0.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者为什么不再来了？荆棘卫队又在哪里？我要走了，...

say:8:1011716007:1.text: I know you made a vow to take on the form of thorns and guard the forest when you joined the Thorned Guards.
say:8:1011716007:1.source_cn: 我知道大家加入荆棘卫队时，立下的誓言是化身荆棘，守护丛林。

say:9:1011716008:0.text: Tell me, why did Eomir stand by and watch our beloved people lose their homes to the corruption without intervening?
say:9:1011716008:0.source_cn: 那为什么，当我们亲爱的同族被腐化夺去家园时，伊米尔却袖...

choice_prompt:10:1011716008.text: Tell me, why did Eomir stand by and watch our beloved people lose their homes to the corruption without intervening?
choice_prompt:10:1011716008.source_cn: 那为什么，当我们亲爱的同族被腐化夺去家园时，伊米尔却袖手旁观，任由大家流离失所呢？！

say:11:1011716009:1.text: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!
say:11:1011716009:1.source_cn: ……薄暮和外乡人，你们的话不可信！
say:11:1011716009:1.male: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!
say:11:1011716009:1.female: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!

say:13:1011716010:1.text: Why would Master Eomir corrupt the sacred Lucent Tree?!
say:13:1011716010:1.source_cn: 贤者有什么理由腐化我们的圣树？！

say:14:1011716011:1.text: Misarte bestowed upon us the Lucent Tree, a sight for generations of children to behold.
say:14:1011716011:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒将流荧树赐予我们，多少代孩子，都仰望着它渐渐成长。

say:16:1011716012:1.text: The sacred tree is eternal, but with the corruption spread throughout the entire forest, Eomir is able to corrupt the Lucent Tree itself and seize its life force for himself.
say:16:1011716012:1.source_cn: 圣树是不朽的，但是通过遍布整片丛林的腐化法阵，伊米尔可...

say:17:1011716013:1.text: Eomir has gained power, status, and your trust. However, he has reached the twilight of his life.
say:17:1011716013:1.source_cn: 伊米尔……他已经有了权力和地位，有了信任着他的你们，但...

say:18:1011716014:1.text: There is only one thing in the world that makes a man willing to give up power and fame...
say:18:1011716014:1.source_cn: 世界上，只有一件事能让人甘愿放弃权力和名望……

say:23:1011716017:1.text: Dear members of the Thorned Faction, please take a look at our Lucent Tree!
say:23:1011716017:1.source_cn: 荆棘，睁开双眼，看看我们的流荧圣树！

say:24:1011716018:1.text: Look at its roots, the spring beneath its shade, and the leaves that once sparkled like stars—what has become of them now?!
say:24:1011716018:1.source_cn: 它的根系，荫蔽下的清泉，曾经闪烁如繁星一般的叶片，现在...

say:25:1011716019:1.text: It's not we who corrupted the Lucent Tree, but Eomir, in whom your trust lies. I will no longer address him as a sage, for he is not a sage but a sinner of the forest!
say:25:1011716019:1.source_cn: 腐化流荧树的不是我们，而是你们一直信赖的伊米尔——我不...

say:27:1011716021:1.text: Yes, I am the Scion of the Lucent Tree.

say:28:1011716022:0.text: Now, I'd like to tell everyone what I heard from the Lucent Tree.
say:28:1011716022:0.source_cn: 而今，我要告知诸位，我清楚地听到了流荧树的声音。

say:29:1011716023:1.text: I heard its prayers tainted by corruption, filled with sorrow for our blindness, yet it persisted in seeking Misarte's forgiveness.
say:29:1011716023:1.source_cn: ——那是被腐化侵染，为我们的盲目和轻信悲痛，却还在恳求...

say:30:1011716024:1.text: Misarte above! Did you really hear the voice of the Lucent Tree?!
say:30:1011716024:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒有灵……！你真的听到流荧树的声音了？！

say:31:1011716025:1.text: Master Eomir... Is it true what they just said?
say:31:1011716025:1.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者，我们……他们说的，是真的吗？

say:33:1011716026:1.text: Nonsense! There's no such thing as the Scion of the Lucent Tree! In the name of the thorn, I command you to take them down!
say:33:1011716026:1.source_cn: 胡扯，根本没有什么流荧树之子！以荆棘的名义，我命令你们...

say:35:1011716028:1.text: Misarte gave us eyes to see right and wrong, and ears to hear the true voices of the forest.
say:35:1011716028:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒赐予了我们明辨是非的双目，又使我们的双耳可以倾听...

say:36:1011716029:1.text: Children of the forest, I implore you to see and hear the truth.
say:36:1011716029:1.source_cn: 丛林的子民，我恳求你们，澄清视界，倾听衷言。

say:37:1011716030:1.text: And use your weapons against the true enemy of the Dark Forest—Eomir!
say:37:1011716030:1.source_cn: 然后，将你们的武器对准薄暮丛林真正的敌人——伊米尔！

say:41:1011716033:1.text: Eomir, this is the last time...

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 伊米尔才是腐化的真凶
